ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent case of the Minneapolis man charged with stealing over $3M from the program.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state improve oversight and accountability in the Medicaid system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system. By analyzing data and conducting interviews, we can shed light on the issue and provide recommendations for improvement.
